sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: My prior: the market treats PTBA as a policy-capped, terminal-value coal name whose earnings and dividend are hostage to the DMO and the state's fiscal needs, and will not pay for the reserve base or rail/port corridor.

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
**Earnings-quality gate: PASS.** Accruals (NI−CFO)/avg assets: FY2023 +7.1%, FY2024 +0.1%, FY2025 −7.8% (dossier) — earnings do not outrun cash. Related-party coal revenue Rp21,253bn, 50.7% of coal revenue (F14, LK FY2025 p.127) is PSAK 7 optics, not a fault: the state sets both ceiling and royalty, and H1-2026 realised sits below the reference price at the paid blended rate (F26, F27). Unmodified EY opinion, no special notation (report §6); no pledge or rights issue; MIND ID 65.93% (F21); buyback under review, undisclosed to OJK (F23) — catalyst, not value. The dossier's 130.6% payout is a timing artefact; FY2025 declared dividend was 45% of profit (F20).

Drivers: volume 49.5 Mt FY2026E (F17, S3), 50 Mt after (S3/S4/S7); realised-to-benchmark 0.4635 FY2026E (F26/F18) reverting to 0.5175 (F13/F1); 54% domestic medium-CV book (F15, S7 p.65); Newcastle 137/118/110/105 (coal deck `newc`, Pink Sheet S23); FX 17,570→18,600 (macro deck); cash cost Rp653,597/t (S5 p.128); D&A Rp44,334/t from the audited Rp2,014bn charge (F7/F1); capex Rp77,159/t (F9/F1); royalty 10.31% (F11/F13); SG&A 6.445% (F24, F30-32); tax 20.765%; payout 60% is my argued normal-year assumption (coverage/companies/PTBA.JK/assumptions.yaml payout basis), not F20 — the FY2025A actual was 45% (F20). FY2026E is heavy in H2: revenue must step 54% h/h (55.97tn vs 22.03tn, F19) on the deck's Q4 war-premium curve.

sections.heading: Valuation and EV math
sections.markdown:
**Engine.** Life-of-reserve NAV at the deck's marker, Newcastle US$105/t (coal deck `newc.lt`, reviewed 2026-10-26; Pink Sheet October-2026; Indonesian marginal supply clears US$100-110/t). Realisation 0.5175 and long-run FX 19,000 give Rp1,032,412/t; FY2025A costs, nominal-consistent escalation; 2,883 Mt reserves (F5) fund 57.7 years at 50 Mt/yr; WACC 14.14% = rf_idr 7.45% + Indonesia ERP 6.69% (macro deck; beta 1.0, net cash; ±200bp → Rp4,293-5,604). Through-cycle FCF Rp5,308bn/yr; 58-year annuity factor 8.36; PV Rp44,375bn + net cash Rp665bn (cash 4,522.2 − debt 3,857.2) + associates Rp10,713bn (S6 p.7) = **Rp55,754bn, Rp4,842/share**. Spot US$150.35/t is cycle position, not value (bull Rp7,903, bear Rp2,488).

**Output contract.** Cash cost ≈US$39.7/t against a US$100-110/t marginal anchor — low-cost half, carried second quartile (no public quartile table archived; moat is the rail/port corridor, S7). Realisation haircut: none (0.5175 is FY2025A actual). Dividend anchor: through-cycle FCF capacity Rp461/share is 9.5% of NAV. Net debt/EBITDA −0.22x; trough cover is net cash. Frame: coal NEUTRAL, BoP/CAUTIOUS, IDR 19,000 lt.

**Levels.** Target = base NAV Rp4,842; kill = falsification Rp2,488. At the market's Rp3,100 the probability-weighted return is 13.1%/yr, below the 14.14% rate at which the NAV is discounted — an internal inconsistency, not a valuation call. The entry is set where the trade clears its own hurdle: Rp3,000, 38% below NAV and 14.4%/yr (SIZING_EV_BASE_RATES: the entry level is where the trade works). Max fill Rp3,090 (3% chase) stays below spot Rp3,100; the 3.2% gap below spot costs fill probability and is not chased.

**EV.** up +61.4% (4,842/3,000), down −17.1% (2,488/3,000); p_up 0.42 at `commodity_capex_turnaround`, no deviation (RKAB discipline real — 790 Mt from 836 Mt, F22 — but price risk balances it); p_down 0.58. Net dividend 11.59% pa: FY2026-28 gross DPS 382.46/433.31/343.69, average 386.49, less 10% withholding = 347.84, /3,000. Drag 1.0% (0.15 buy + 0.25 sell + 0.10 sell tax + 0.50 slippage). **expected_pct = 0.42×61.4 − 0.58×17.1 + 34.8 − 1.0 = +49.7%**; dividend-free +14.9%. The 45% payout sensitivity: net div 8.70% pa and the hurdle-clearing entry falls to ~Rp2,850. up_pct is re-read off the new entry, not raised as an estimate. Symmetry 3.59 vs library 2.14; own-Kelly **+1.51**, library-Kelly **+0.43** — the gap is the entry discount.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. H1-2026 production 19.45 Mt, sales 21.10 Mt (F18, S2) — annualised ~39 Mt; FY2026E needs ~28.4 Mt in H2, +35%.
2. H1-2026 realised-to-benchmark fell to 0.4635 from 0.5175 (F26/F18): the medium-CV, 54%-domestic blend does not carry a Newcastle spike.
3. FY2025 EBIT fell to Rp3,208bn from Rp5,652bn on flat revenue; gross margin 14.7% from 19.2% (F28/F29).
4. Capex tripled to Rp3,505bn against FCF of Rp2,756bn (F9).
5. The declared FY2025 dividend was Rp114.50/share, Rp1.31tn (F20), from ~Rp332 in FY2024 — the anchor halves at the trough.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is late 2029 and the position is down 30%. The likely cause is the marker, not PTBA: RKAB discipline loosens and Chinese/Indian restarts push Newcastle below US$95/t, realised price sits under cash cost plus capex, the dividend is cut to the 30% floor, and the market capitalises reserves at run-off. Second, the H2-2026 volume miss becomes normal (39-42 Mt annualised leaves no FCF). Third, a state-directed buyback or downstream project at a valuation we would not underwrite. Gap risk: a band-exceeding shock suspends the price kill and escalates (Constitution §5), so a clamped fill can make the realised down-leg worse than the −17.1% kill loss.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** after +39.1% over 12 months, PTBA has priced the Newcastle war premium (spot US$150.35 vs the deck's US$105); its medium-CV, 54%-domestic book cannot carry the spike, H1-2026's 0.4635 ratio is the new normal, and the state's 65.93% stake subordinates minority cash flow.

**Why wrong:** the market is right on long-run price (~US$103 implied) but wrong on mechanism and tail: it treats a trough half-year realisation as permanent, truncates reserve life at the house's 25-year life-end test, and pays nothing for Rp10.7tn of associates plus net cash. At Rp3,100 the enterprise is ~Rp20.7tn against ~Rp5.3tn through-cycle FCF. Edge tag: **analytical (a)** — mis-modelled realisation/D&A, not a price call.

**What proves us wrong:** Newcastle/HBA below US$95/t for two quarters; RKAB above ~800 Mt with PTBA volume above plan and the realised ratio falling; FY2027 payout below the 30% floor with capex above Rp4tn and negative FCF; or the stock breaking Rp2,488 without a coal-price recovery.

sections.heading: Microstructure and liquidity
sections.markdown: Free float 34.07% (100 − MIND ID 65.93%, F21/S7 p.82; state Dwiwarna share; exact float unavailable); no pledge or rights issue (Phase 1). 30d value traded Rp138.46bn (screen 2026-10-28), 69x the Rp2bn constitutional floor. A 5% NAV position (Rp767mn on Rp15.34bn) is 0.55% of one day's ADV; at 20% participation (Rp27.7bn/day) days-to-exit is 0.03 days — one session, inside the 7-day cap. Board lot 100 (≈Rp300k). The ARA/ARB band is 25%; from the Rp3,000 entry the kill at Rp2,488 is −17.1%, inside one band. A move beyond the band suspends a price kill and escalates (Constitution §5), so the −25% clamp is an escalation tail carried in the pre-mortem, not the base exit. Flow: flows stale — `fund record` has no PTBA entry and the INDO regime has 0 fresh readings; foreign ownership is unavailable. I claim no flow edge — neither capitulation nor chase. Buyback under review, no OJK disclosure (F23, S2).

sections.heading: Optionality and ARA note
sections.markdown: `horizon: long`, so no `catalyst_date` is required and none is set. Not in NAV: the undated buyback (F23); 2,830 Mt of resources above the 2,883 Mt reserve base (F5); associates carried at book. The house dates the Q3-2026 interim 2026-11-30 and a buyback decision by 2026-12-31; monitoring points, not a catalyst trade.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: Same marker (newc lt US$105/t) and the same 2,883 Mt reserve base. Two differences: my WACC is 14.14% (rf 7.45% + ERP 6.69%, beta 1.0, no debt weight) against the house's 11.21% (levered beta 0.85, 7.3% debt), and my DCF runs the full 57.7-year reserve life against the house's FY2050E life-end truncation (~25 years). The errors largely offset: my base NAV Rp4,842 is 1.8% above the house base Rp4,758.6. My target is base NAV, not the house's weighted Rp5,303.2 (25% bull at Rp9,430), which I treat as unearned optionality. My kill Rp2,488 is 9.8% above the house bear Rp2,265.9 because US$95/t is the falsification marker, not a 20% shock.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**0. Fact-check.** NAV Rp4,842 ties to F5 (2,883/50 = 57.7y), F13/F1, F17/F18/F19/F26; reconciles. 8.36 is a growing-annuity factor (~2.2%), not the 7.07 level factor at 14.14%. No fabrication. [MINOR]

**1. Estimates.** Widest bar: the 0.5175 realisation reversion, not H2 revenue. At 0.4635 the margin falls 20-30% and NAV to ~Rp3,500-3,750 — up +13-21%, price-only EV negative at 0.42 — fragile, single-assumption dependency. H2 EBIT must step 172% h/h. [MATERIAL]

**2. Variant.** House reverse DCF implies ~US$103/t, so the variant is not price. The bulk of the gap is Rp11.4tn associates + net cash — a holdco/SOTP discount, not a capex turnaround; the reserve-life extension nets to 1.8% of NAV. [MATERIAL]

**3. Base rate/sleeve.** `commodity_capex_turnaround` (0.42) flatters a catalyst-free SOTP discount; `holdco_discount_narrowing` (0.33) requires a NAMED catalyst, and the buyback is undisclosed (F23). At 0.33 EV ~38. MOMENTUM sleeve (rank 9; mom1 −0.32) is a third, unargued frame. [MATERIAL]

**4. Construction.** kill < entry < target coherent; up/down 2.85 vs library 2.14. But down_pct −19.7 uses the kill price, not the ARB-clamped fill the thesis cites (2,325, −25%); at −25 EV is 41.8/33.4 (60%/45% payout). Loss leg 5.3pp too small. [MATERIAL]

**5. Disconfirming fact.** House report: Tanjung Enim Air Laya IUP No. 94/1/IUP/PMDN/2020 runs to 31 Dec 2030, "short of the modelled horizon, so every modelled year past that date assumes the company renews its IUPs on time" (coverage/companies/PTBA.JK/report.md, DCF). Non-renewal leaves ~Rp2,330. [MATERIAL]

**6. Pre-mortem.** It blames marker, volume, state allocation, omitting demand: the macro desk holds thermal coal NEUTRAL because "the structural export-tailwind fade into 2027 is unchanged" (the macro regime memo); a 57.7-year flat-real-US$105 DCF assumes a six-decade seaborne market. [MATERIAL]

**7. Anti-gaming.** stage_log holds only draft at 13:35:55; screen CSV mtime 11:01:05 predates estimates_committed_at by 2h34m; no Phase-1 artifact, so price-free commitment is unverifiable. The 60% payout cites F20, which says 45%. Verbatim: "5% NAV position (Rp767mn on Rp15.34tn)" — book is Rp15.34bn, not tn. [MATERIAL]

**8. Stop-objecting.** At Rp3,100 the +44.8%/3y EV is 13.1%/yr, below the 14.14% WACC; at the 45% actual and ARB-clamped −25%, EV +33.4% (10.1%/yr). I stop objecting at ~Rp2,950 if 60% payout confirmed, or ~Rp2,780 at 45% (EV clears 14.14%). [MATERIAL]

**9. Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** No FATAL; EV positive. The +44.8% EV is three-quarters dividend and 13.1%/yr — below the 14.14% WACC — and at the 45% actual with the ARB-clamped kill the entry clearing the hurdle is Rp2,780, not Rp3,100. [MATERIAL]

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
0. **HELD** — no defect: NAV ties to F5/F13/F1/F17-F19/F26; 8.36 is the growing-annuity factor. [MINOR]
1. **HELD** — the method card fixes realisation on the last *actual* (0.5175, F13/F1), not a default haircut; H1's 0.4635 is struck against a US$128.85 war-premium denominator and already carried in FY2026E. Permanent 0.4635 is the review case; US$95/t (Rp2,488) is the falsification.
2. **PARTLY CONCEDED** — associates plus net cash are Rp11.4tn, 20.4% of NAV and over half the discount gap; the load-bearing 79.6% is the mining DCF.
3. **PARTLY CONCEDED** — balance-sheet leg real, but `holdco_discount_narrowing` needs a NAMED catalyst and the buyback is undisclosed (F23); RKAB discipline is real (790 vs 836 Mt, F22), so the 0.42 key stands.
4. **PARTLY CONCEDED** — "size on the clamped fill" is corrected: under Constitution §5 a band-exceeding move suspends a price kill, so the down leg is the loss at the falsification level, not the −25% tail.
5. **PARTLY CONCEDED** — life past 2030 is permit-conditional; base assumes on-time renewal (S7 p.84), non-renewal ≈Rp2,330 sits below the Rp2,488 kill, and the house's truncated base (Rp4,758.6) is within 1.8%.
6. **PARTLY CONCEDED** — 57.7 years is a supply-cost annuity, not a demand forecast; the fade is in the US$95/t bear marker, terminal growth is zero, target within 1.8% of the house.
7. **CONCEDED** — Rp15.34tn→Rp15.34bn; the 60% payout is cited to fund record (F20's actual is 45%); Phase 1 (13:35:55) and Phase 2 were separate spawns edited into one file, so no on-disk price-blind artifact survives — not claimed.
8. **CONCEDED** — at Rp3,100 EV is 13.1%/yr, below the 14.14% WACC. Entry moves to Rp3,000 (max fill Rp3,090), where EV is 14.4%/yr; a 45% payout print puts the clearing entry at ~Rp2,850. The 3.2% gap costs fill probability; no chase.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Correction applied.** The standing record (inception → 2026-10-15: 40 theses, 35 KILL, 5 PASS_REDUCED, 0 fills; 12 of 28 scored kills left gains; a kill spends a real cooldown on a screened name) is over-killing, not over-buying. I do not kill on price or uncertainty: a positive-EV, house-corroborated thesis passes at reduced size.

**PASS_REDUCED, size_multiplier 0.5.** Lint PASS (one warning: 2308 words > 1600). The stage chain draft 13:35:55 → attacked 14:17:55 → revision 14:38:59 is monotonic with correct actors; the nine-point Bear log is present and answered; no gamed pipeline. The missing price-blind artifact is disclosed, not claimed — not a process kill.

1. **Archetype.** p_up 0.42 is the registry prior, undeviated. 79.6% of NAV is the mining DCF; RKAB discipline is sourced (790 vs 836 Mt, F22). The 20.4% holdco/SOTP leg does not make this a `holdco_discount_narrowing` thesis. No p_up or target was raised.
2. **Down leg.** −17.1% is the mechanical loss at the valuation-derived falsification (2,488), not a stop; §5 suspends a price kill on a band-exceeding move, so the −25% clamp is a disclosed escalation tail. Honest as constructed, but the archetype's base_down is −35%; that optimism costs size.
3. **Payout.** 60% is cited to fund record and is the house normal-year assumption; the 45% FY2025 trough is disclosed. At 45% the clearing entry is ~Rp2,850, below Rp3,000, and the dividend is two-thirds of EV. Main scar.
4. **Realisation/reserves.** 0.5175 is FY2025A actual (F13/F1) per the method card; permanent 0.4635 gives NAV Rp3,500-3,750, not a target hit. The 57.7-year life assumes on-time IUP renewal past 2030 (S7 p.84); non-renewal ≈Rp2,330 is below the kill and lacks a permit KPI. Second unverified input.
5. **House reconciliation.** Rp4,842 is 1.8% above house base Rp4,758.6 and below house weighted Rp5,303.2 — no contradiction.
6. **Price.** Rp3,000 clears 14.4%/yr at the argued payout; the Rp3,090 max fill (~13.5%/yr) does not. Rest at Rp3,000; do not chase. This is a PASS at this price, not a kill.

**0.5 because** two load-bearing inputs (60% payout, post-2030 renewal) remain argued-but-unverified and the down leg is optimistic against the −35% archetype; the idea is right-shaped and house-corroborated, so half, not zero.

**Session close:** 1 chain judged (PTBA.JK) — 1 PASS_REDUCED (0.5), 0 PASS, 0 KILL. PTBA was passable and passed. T-GLOBAL-MRK-001, killed earlier today on valuation, was not a construction casualty — its honest base value (135) sat below spot (141.82) at every fillable entry, so it would not have been passable however built.
